meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让看不见图片的模型也能读出图中的文字、版面和语义。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果所用模型没有原生视觉能力,却要处理对话里的图片。
copy.tagline_en: Give text-only models vision by turning images into structured text.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your model lacks native vision but must handle images in chat.

howto.what: 当对话中出现你看不见的图片路径、链接或占位符时,Claude 会改用 modlens 命令行把图片转成结构化 JSON 证据(逐字文字、版面区域、语义等),再据此回答,而不是自己猜或临时写 OCR。
howto.when: 当对话中出现带图片扩展名的路径或 URL、`[Image #1]` 等占位符,而你看不到图内容时触发;用户问安装、配置或切换提供方时也会用。

say.text: 用 modlens 读一下 ./screenshot.png,告诉我里面写了什么
say.note: 返回 JSON,含逐字文本与版面区域

say.text: 先跑 modlens guard,看看当前模型能不能自己读图
say.note: 退出码 1 表示该模型应自己读图

say.text: 帮我配置 modlens 的 Gemini API key
say.note: 通过 modlens config set 写入密钥

howto.what_en: When an image path, URL, or placeholder you can't see appears, Claude runs the modlens CLI to turn it into structured JSON evidence — transcribed words, layout regions, semantics — and answers from that JSON instead of guessing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an image path or URL, a `[Image #1]` placeholder, or an `[Unsupported Image]` line appears and you can't see the image; also when users ask to install or configure modlens.

say_en.text: Use modlens to read ./screenshot.png and tell me what it says
say_en.note: Returns JSON with full text and layout

say_en.text: Run modlens guard to check if this model can see images itself
say_en.note: Exit 1 means the model reads images itself

say_en.text: Help me configure the Gemini API key for modlens
say_en.note: Writes provider keys via modlens config set
